description: 2 tactical challenges for Black against the Hopton Attack. Develop with 2...Nf6! and recapture toward the center.

drills.briefExplanation: 1...f5 2.Bg5 Nf6! 3.Bxf6 exf6 — just develop; the pin costs White a tempo.
drills.description: Black to play. White pins with the Hopton 2.Bg5 — play 1...f5 and develop calmly.
drills.explanation: The calm defense: after 1...f5 2.Bg5, Black simply plays 2...Nf6! — developing and ignoring the pin. After 3.Bxf6 exf6 Black's structure is slightly damaged, but White spent two moves on the bishop excursion; Black will play ...d5, ...e6, and castle, with a playable Dutch. Don't fear the pin — outdevelop it.
drills.name: Ignoring the Pin

drills.briefExplanation: 2...Nf6 3.Bxf6 gxf6! 4.e4 d6 — recapture toward the center and build the wall.
drills.description: Black to play. White pinned 2.Bg5 — develop and recapture toward the center.
drills.explanation: The principled recapture: after 2...Nf6 3.Bxf6, Black plays 3...gxf6! — recapturing toward the center, opening the g-file for the rook, and keeping the pawn mass mobile. After 4.e4 d6 Black builds the Stonewall-style center; the 'damaged' structure is actually flexible, and White's bishop is gone. Recapture toward the center — a lifelong rule.
drills.name: Recapturing Toward Center
